summary: Clearmind Medicine filed a Form 6-K attaching a July 30, 2026 press release reporting positive safety and tolerability results from Part A of its FDA-regulated Phase I/II trial of CMND-100 in Alcohol Use Disorder. All 24 participants across four ascending-dose cohorts (20-160 mg) completed treatment; no serious adverse events occurred. The filing is a routine clinical trial update with no special-situation activities such as acquisitions, divestitures, or strategic changes. No deal terms or board actions apply.
